title.narrative: Mobilizing local resources for succour to the less privileged

description.narrative:
The Nigerian Bishops Conference of Nigeria established Caritas Nigeria as the relief and development arm of the Church. With this premise, the Bishops’ expected Caritas Nigeria to serve as the first respondents when disaster strikes in Nigeria. This is an important mandate that cannot be achieved without adequate resources. As part of the discussions with CAFOD, there was an understanding that CAFOD will provide seed grants to Caritas Nigeria to enable the resource mobilization drive. Hence, this project. Nigeria is currently facing protracted humanitarian situation across the country causing massive displacements. Due to this situation, the Nigerian Bishops Conference of Nigeria establish the “Humanitarian Basket Fund.” This fund is designed to support humanitarian interventions within Nigeria and beyond.
The project compliments CAFOD's vision of voice and agency including local leadership in Nigeria. The ability of partners to raise undesignated funds from Catholic faithful is vital to ensure financial sustenance. Caritas Nigeria appreciates CAFOD's commitment to it's survival and recognizes that mirroring CAFOD's approach in Nigeria would not be an easy process. The project is a result of several visits to CAFOD UK office and the lessons from those trips includes CAFOD's assurance of support for Caritas Nigeria on resource mobilisation drive.
